page.overview:
Who is Joel D'Agostino?

Joel D'Agostino is the main protagonist of Kids at Play, the second story of Fazbear Frights 11: Prankster.

Joel inherited his father's strong features and his mother's big and heavily lashed brown eyes. He is tall with narrow hips and thick, wavy black hair. Many girls consider Joel good-looking or gorgeous, with many complimenting his usual outfit of jeans and black T-shirts. However, he rarely takes showers.
